name: HR 1. Department compensation and performance
rawText:
# Would you know which departments cost the most and how well they perform?
# 
#   - How many employees does each department have?
#   - What is the average employee salary?
#   - What is the total annual payroll for each department?
#   - Which departments achieved the highest average performance ratings in 2025?
#   - How much bonus compensation did each department distribute in 2025?
#   - Which departments have the largest payroll commitments?
# 
# What if you could combine employee data, salary information, and historical performance reviews 
# — including conditional and nested aggregations 
# — into a single readable query?
# No complex SQL. No manually written joins. No separate queries for each calculation.
# 
# Just describe what you want to know. Let OQuery handle the complexity.
# ____________________________________________________________
 
Departments:
    Name
    Employees.Count(Id) TotalEmployees
    Employees.Avg(Salary) AverageSalary
    Employees.Sum(Salary) AnnualPayroll
    Employees.Avg(PerformanceReviews.AvgIf(Rating, ReviewYear = 2025)) AverageRating
    Employees.Sum(PerformanceReviews.SumIf(BonusAmount, ReviewYear = 2025)) TotalBonuses 
 Order AnnualPayroll ASC
